zai-search.description: Z.ai web search (web_search_prime) with domain and recency filters

zai-reader.description: Z.ai URL reader — fetch a web page as clean markdown/text

zai-zread.description: Z.ai zread — search public GitHub repositories, read files, list directories

zai-vision.description: Z.ai vision (GLM) — image/video analysis: UI-to-code, OCR, error screenshot diagnosis, diagrams, charts, UI diff

docling.description: Docling - convert PDFs to agent-readable markdown (used in agent-builder/blackmagic/headunit)

ghidra.description: GhidraMCP (bethington fork) — decompile, list/rename functions, symbols, xrefs, types in the Ghidra DB. Bridge + Ghidra extension are installed by the ghidra feature (bridge at /usr/local/bin/bridge-mcp-ghidra). Requires Ghidra running with the GhidraMCP server started (HTTP API on 127.0.0.1:8089); call connect_instance first — the headless server registers as project "unknown". (used in blepoolsensor)

gdb.description: GDB/MI multi-session debugger for local binaries, core dumps, and gdbserver targets (used in blepoolsensor)

logic-analyzer.description: USB logic analyzer via sigrok or simulator: capture digital signals and decode UART, I2C, SPI. Project-bound: cwd points at the blepoolsensor logic-analyzer-mcp checkout — adjust cwd or copy the project before enabling elsewhere. (used in blepoolsensor)
